title: nasturtium × anceps
intro: Nasturtium × anceps, commonly known as Tropaeolum majus, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Tropaeolaceae family. This plant is valued for its edible flowers, leaves, and stems, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, providing several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nasturtium × anceps include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and nutritional value.
